newsitem.title: CHINA: Zhejiang Power to list soon in London, Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Zhejiang Power to list soon in London, Shanghai.

text.p: China's Zhejiang Southeast Electric Power is expected to make its initial public offering of B shares in Shanghai and global depositary shares in London early this northern summer, BZW Asia Ltd said on Wednesday.
It will be the first such dual listing of B shares in Shanghai and London, BZW officials told a news conference.
BZW is acting as global coordinator for the offer.
B shares are issued domestically but are traded in foreign currency and are aimed at foreign investors.
Beijing Datang Power was the first Chinese company to list its shares in London. It also has a listing of H shares in Hong Kong.
